title: Right Here Waiting
zh: 此情可待（無論你在何方，我都在此等候）
speaker: Richard Marx
desc: Richard Marx · 跨越時空與距離的深情守候
en: Oceans apart, day after day,
and I slowly go insane.
I hear your voice on the line,
but it doesn't stop the pain.
If I see you next to never,
how can we say forever?
Wherever you go,
whatever you do,
I will be right here waiting for you.
Whatever it takes,
or how my heart breaks,
I took for granted all the times
that I thought would last somehow.
I hear the laughter, I taste the tears,
but I can't get near you now.
Oh, can't you see it, baby?
You've got me going crazy.
I wonder how we can survive this romance,
but in the end if I'm with you, I'll take the chance.
cn: 相隔萬里，日復一日，
我漸漸瀕臨瘋狂。
電話裡傳來你的聲音，
卻無法止住這份痛苦。
若我們幾乎無緣再見，
我們又怎能談及永遠？
無論你身在何方，
無論你做什麼，
我都會在這裡守候著你。
無論付出什麼代價，
哪怕我心碎成片，
我把一起度過的時光視為理所當然
以為它們不知為何會永遠延續。
我聽見笑聲，我嚐到淚水，
但我如今無法靠近你。
噢，你難道看不見嗎，寶貝？
你讓我為你瘋狂著迷。
我納悶我們該如何維繫這段愛戀，
但只要最後能與你相伴，我願賭上一切。

title: Mine
zh: 我的摯愛（你是我遇見過最美好的意外）
speaker: Taylor Swift
desc: Taylor Swift · 相信愛能克服恐懼的溫暖告白
en: Oh, oh, oh.
Oh oh oh oh.
You were in college working part-time waiting tables,
left a small town, never looked back.
I was a flight risk with a fear of fallin',
wondering why we bother with love if it never lasts.
I say, 'Can you believe it?'
As we're lying on the couch,
the moment I can see it,
yes, yes, I can see it now.
Do you remember, we were sitting there by the water?
You put your arm around me for the first time.
You made a rebel of a careless man's careful daughter.
You are the best thing that's ever been mine.
You are the best thing
that's ever been mine.
You are the best thing that's ever been mine.
Flash forward and we're taking on the world together,
and there's a drawer of my things at your place.
And I hear the lyrics to our song.
And I remember that fight, two-thirty AM,
as everything was slipping right out of our hands.
I ran out crying and you followed me out into the street,
braced myself for the goodbye, 'cause that's all I've ever known.
Then you took me by surprise.
You said, 'I'll never leave you alone.'
You never smile at me like you do right now.
You said, 'I remember how we felt sitting by the water.'
And every time I look at you, it's like the first time.
Mine, mine, mine.
Do you believe it?
We're gonna make it now.
And I can see it — I can see it now.
cn: 嗯，嗯，嗯。

我曾膽小怯懦，害怕墜入愛河，
不禁懷疑，愛情若無法長久，又何必費心。
我說：「你能相信嗎？」
就在我們相依靠在沙發上時，
那個瞬間我清楚地看見了，
是的，我看見了，我確實看見了。
你記得嗎，我們坐在水邊的那一刻？
你第一次把手臂環繞在我的肩上。
你讓這個謹慎父親粗心大意的女兒，變得叛逆。
你是我所擁有過最美好的事物。
你是最美好的事物
我曾擁有過的最美好的事物。
你是我所擁有過最美好的事物。
快轉到我們一同闖蕩世界，
你的地方有一整個抽屜放著我的東西。
我聽到我們歌曲的歌詞。
我記得那場爭吵，凌晨兩點半，
一切都在我們指縫間溜走。
我哭著跑出去，你跟著我衝到街上，
我做好了道別的準備，因為那是我唯一熟悉的結局。
但你卻令我大感意外。
你說：「我永遠不會撇下你一個人。」
你從來沒有像現在這樣對我微笑。
你說：「我記得我們坐在水邊時的感受。」
每次我看著你，都像第一次見面般心跳加速。
是我的，是我的，是我的。
你相信嗎？
我們現在就要成功了。
而我看得見——我現在看得見了。

title: Love Story
zh: 愛的故事（羅密歐與茱麗葉的完美結局）
speaker: Taylor Swift
desc: Taylor Swift · 風靡全球的童話浪漫經典
en: We were both young when I first saw you.
I close my eyes and the flashback starts:
I'm standing there on a balcony in summer air.
See the lights, see the party, the ball gowns,
see you make your way through the crowd
and say, 'Hello.'
Little did I know
that you were Romeo, you were throwing pebbles,
and my daddy said, 'Stay away from Juliet.'
And I was crying on the staircase,
begging you, 'Please don't go.'
And I said, 'Romeo, take me somewhere we can be alone.'
'I'll be waiting. All there's left to do is run.'
'You'll be the prince and I'll be the princess,
it's a love story, baby, just say yes.'
So I sneak out to the garden to see you,
we keep quiet 'cause we're dead if they knew.
So close your eyes, escape this town for a little while.
'Romeo, save me. I've been feeling so alone.'
'I keep waiting for you but you never come.'
'Is this in my head? I don't know what to think.'
He knelt to the ground and pulled out a ring and said,
'Marry me, Juliet, you'll never have to be alone.'
'I love you and that's all I really know.'
'I talked to your dad, go pick out a white dress.'
'It's a love story, baby, just say yes.'
Oh, oh, oh,
oh, oh, oh, oh.
'Romeo, save me, I've been feeling so alone.'
'I keep waiting for you but you never come.'
Just say yes.
This love story, baby, just say yes.
Just say yes.
cn: 第一次看見你的時候，我們都還年輕。
我閉上眼睛，回憶的畫面開始浮現：
我站在夏日微風中的陽台上。
看見燈光，看見派對，看見舞會禮服，
看見你穿越人群走來
然後說，「你好。」
我當時渾然不知
原來你就是羅密歐，正在拋擲小石頭，
而我父親說，「離茱麗葉遠一點。」
我坐在樓梯上哭泣，
懇求你，「請別走。」
於是我說，「羅密歐，帶我去一個只屬於我們的地方。」
「我將等候。剩下唯一要做的事，就是逃跑。」
「你是王子，而我是公主，
這是一段愛情故事，寶貝，只要你說好。」
於是我偷溜到花園來見你，
我們保持安靜，因為若被發現我們就完了。
所以閉上眼睛，暫時逃離這座城鎮。
「羅密歐，救救我。我感到如此孤單。」
「我一直等待著你，你卻始終未來。」
「這只是我的幻想嗎？我不知道該如何思考。」
他單膝跪地，拿出一枚戒指說，
「茱麗葉，嫁給我，你永遠不再孤單。」
「我愛你，這是我真正確信的一切。」
「我已和你父親談過了，去挑一件白色禮服吧。」
「這是一段愛情故事，寶貝，只要你說好。」
哦，哦，哦，
哦，哦，哦，哦。
「羅密歐，救救我，我感到如此孤單。」
「我一直等待著你，你卻始終未來。」
只要說好。
這段愛情故事，寶貝，只要說好。
只要說好。

title: You Belong With Me
zh: 你屬於我（最懂你的人一直在我這裡）
speaker: Taylor Swift
desc: Taylor Swift · 青春校園暗戀與真愛共鳴
en: You're on the phone with your girlfriend,
she's upset, she's going off on you.
She doesn't get your humor like I do.
I'm in the room, it's a typical Tuesday night.
And she'll never know your story like I do.
But she wears short skirts,
I wear T-shirts.
She's cheer captain and I'm on the bleachers.
Dreaming about the day when you wake up and find
that what you're looking for has been here the whole time.
If you could see that I'm the one who understands you,
been here all along, so why can't you see?
You belong with me, you belong with me.
Walking the streets with you in your worn-out jeans,
I can't help thinking this is how it ought to be.
Laughing on a park bench, thinking to myself,
hey, isn't this easy?
And you've got a smile that could light up this whole town.
I haven't seen it in a while since she brought you down.
You say you're fine, I know you better than that.
Hey, what you doing with a girl like that?
She wears high heels, I wear sneakers.
I'm listening to the kind of music she doesn't like.
Oh, I remember you driving to my house
in the middle of the night.
I'm the one who makes you laugh
when you know you're about to cry.
I know your favorite songs
and you tell me 'bout your dreams.
Think I know where you belong,
think I know it's with me.

她很不高興，對你大發脾氣。
她不像我一樣懂你的幽默。
我在房間裡，又是平常的週二夜晚。
而她永遠不會像我一樣了解你的故事。
但她穿著短裙，
而我穿著T恤。
她是啦啦隊隊長，而我坐在看台上。
夢想著那天你醒來，發現
你一直在尋覓的，其實一直都在這裡。

一直都在你身邊，為何你就是看不見？

en: How long will I love you?

I wish I could just make you turn around,
